# OpenFlow

> Free, private, zero-limit local AI voice dictation and meeting intelligence for Windows.

OpenFlow is a high-performance Windows desktop application that enables users to dictate text seamlessly into any application (VS Code, Chrome, Slack, Discord, Microsoft Office, Notion, Terminal) with sub-150ms latency. Unlike cloud-based voice dictation services like Wispr Flow, OpenFlow runs 100% locally on the user's hardware via NVIDIA CUDA float16 kernels with CTranslate2 and faster-whisper, with automatic fallback to DirectML and AVX2 CPU execution. Audio and clipboard data never leave the local machine.

## Key Facts
- **Creator**: Sachidananda
- **Platform**: Windows 10 & Windows 11 (64-bit)
- **License**: MIT License (Open Source)
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Sachin1724/OpenFlow
- **Download**: https://github.com/Sachin1724/OpenFlow/releases/download/v1.1.9/OpenFlow-Setup.exe
- **Website**: https://sachin1724.github.io/OpenFlow/
- **Cost**: 100% Free, zero subscriptions, zero usage quotas
- **Privacy**: 100% Offline, no external network transmission of audio

## Core Capabilities
- **Push-to-Talk Global Hotkey**: Hold `Ctrl + Shift` to speak in any application; release to automatically transcribe and paste formatted text directly into the active cursor position via Win32 SendInput.
- **On-Device NPU Acceleration**: Sub-2W execution for Windows 11 Copilot+ PCs (Intel AI Boost / OpenVINO), enabling silent, all-day voice dictation without battery drain.
- **Dynamic Island Floating Capsule HUD**: Translucent Apple-grade dark HUD with iOS-style spring toggle switches, live audio visualizers, and silent boot into capsule mode.
- **Autonomous Meeting Mode**: Background window detection for Google Meet, Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Cisco Webex. Automatically captures meeting dialogue and formats structured executive notes (Agenda, Discussion, Decisions, Action Items) into local SQLite storage.
- **Win32 Live Hardware Microphone Hotplug**: Real-time Windows kernel polling detecting device attachment/removal, with companion notification pill and instant audio channel switching.
- **Multi-Tone Text Refiner**: Intelligent punctuation and filler-word removal with dedicated presets for Smart Clean, Developer/Code voice syntax, Email & Formal, Markdown Bullets, and Verbatim speech.
- **Multilingual Support**: Supports 99+ languages with specialized context prompt injection for Indic dialects (Hindi in Devanagari script, Odia, Hinglish).

## Technical Architecture
- **Inference Engine**: CTranslate2 `float16` Whisper kernels (NVIDIA CUDA) + OpenVINO INT8 (Windows Copilot+ NPU) + Sherpa-ONNX Parakeet (CPU)
- **Audio Capture**: Windows winmm kernel polling + 16kHz PCM stream capture via sounddevice
- **Input Injection**: Windows low-level keyboard hooks (WH_KEYBOARD_LL) + Win32 SendInput with clipboard restoration
- **UI Framework**: PyQt6 with custom vector animations and non-activating window flags
- **Local Storage**: SQLite database (~/.openflow/openflow.db)
